{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cargo Track race''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] competition in the city of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Competitors raced around the [[Center Sphere District]]. Although the race was illegal, the [[Security Chief's Second]] [[Grubber Vapps]] took part on it, racing on "[[Rudy (swoop)|Rudy]]," and commonly winning. Vapps tried to keep this a secret for [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] [[Mix Liddell]]; Liddell discovered it, but he said nothing to Vapps. Once a year, however, there was one approved, legal&mdash;although still dangerous&mdash;race, the [[Cargo Track 3000]].
